queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'Citrix Workspace%' AND name NOT LIKE '%Inside%' AND (publisher LIKE 'Citrix%' OR publisher LIKE 'Cloud Software Group%');
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE (name LIKE 'Citrix Workspace%' AND name NOT LIKE '%Inside%' AND (publisher LIKE 'Citrix%' OR publisher LIKE 'Cloud Software Group%')) AND version_compare(version, '26.7.1.4') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) IN ('selfservice.exe','selfserviceplugin.exe','wfica32.exe'));
